statement: every reflexive descent (a chain of covers, each the next reflexive polytope inside the last) of each of the 473,800,776 reflexive 4-polytopes of the Kreuzer-Skarke list reaches an r-minimal polytope, and with it a seed, in at most 348 steps; the sharp constants are 5 in dimension 2 and 11 in dimension 3
source: Bhattacharjee, Seed Universality for Four-Dimensional Reflexive Polytopes (Preprints.org 2026)
